rationale: Measured acceptance of the pre-existing {.axiomDecision.} debt, replacing the 249 file-scoped grandfather waivers (JSON) and 23 (TOML). Measured at 5ae980f4 those waivers did two things at once: they kept 203 of the 253 violating files (466 of 679 reasons) out of the count altogether — the waiver-era report was 50 files / 213 reasons, the unwaived measurement is 253 / 679 — and they shared one 2026-12-31 expiry that floored a daysRemaining<30 test into a hard build FAIL from 2026-12-01. This baseline records the whole count for the first time, with an owner and a review date, and every file it counts is scanned on every run. Growth fails and a tool may not raise it; the count may only fall. Rationale extraction for the 679 decision points remains open work (DEBT#541).
